thread:
maya: Quick async — safety slice handoff for v2 rollout. I'll run slice-A dry-run + smoke at 10:30 PT. Post what you did / blockers / today. If you need me to hold lift, say so. :rocket:

raj: Done this morning — feature-flag config pushed to staging (ff.v2_safety=true for user-slice-A). Uploaded hashes to configstore. Blocker: dedicated GPU quota at 85% for eu-west-1, opened infra ticket #INF-1279, estimating 3h.

ellie: Investigating a p99 tail on kv-cache for prompt-length>1024 in staging. Seen ~3x latency spike on a single pod. Reproduced with replay harness, isolating batch path.

ben: Ops note — bumped slowstart window to 90s and set batch-max=8 for the slice. Also added a CanaryGuard circuit-breaker: threshold 5% error rate. Command used:
```
redwoodctl rollout update --slice slice-A --slowstart 90s --batch-max 8 --circuit-threshold 5
```

jess: If latency doesn't improve after ellie's changes, plan B is to fallback to v1-quantized variant and keep kv-cache disabled. I've added the rollback snippet to the runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/rollbacks#v2

deploy-bot: deployment pipeline triggered for slice-A -> job 5482 (dry-run). logs: https://ci.redwood/run/5482

maya: For QA — can folks tag smoke results in the thread (latency p95/p99, error %, any regressed outputs)? We'll decide on lifting to 1% by EOD.

tara: Smoke results: p95=230ms, p99=810ms, errors=0.7% (mostly rate-limit transient). No semantic regression seen on the sampled prompts. :thumbsup:

ellie: After disabling a batching path in staging, p99 improved to 420ms. Still seeing islanded spikes; digging into kernel selection logs.

raj: Quota update — infra increased reserved GPUs in eu-west-1; INF-1279 marked in-progress. ETA ~45m.

ben: confirming: hold lift until deploy-bot posts green check. If p99 >600ms after infra change, we hold and run A/B on fallback.

maya: Ack. I'll keep watch and run a quick customer-impact table once we hit 1% lift. Thanks all. :eyes:
